items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: We were traveling in the bus in the Midwest.

ctx.x: We were traveling in the bus in the Midwest. And he said, “This is it, this is where I want to move, I’m going to open my double reed shop right here.” It was in Ohio somewhere, you know.
Yeah, he was a piece of work. But he could talk about anything you know. He was very well read, he just was sharp as a tack.
